current_architecture.sc_role: Operation, monitoring and central data/event logging
current_architecture.count_basis: Explicit correction by Manuel; replaces the prior PDS LV entry. No new supply-module count is inferred.
current_architecture.sc_dps_transport: OPC UA: control requests, status and events between SC/Ignition and the DPS PLC
current_architecture.protection_path: DPS arbitrates protection. PDUs and WIENER supplies share SNMP control/status to the PLC. BDE/bias EtherCAT remote I/O and dedicated PL506/ISEG wired inhibits are visible in the same overview. Additional subsystem OPC UA goes through SC.
current_architecture.proposal_diagram: One detector overview on slide 4; CUC location proposed. Slide 7 explains the inhibit tracing method; slides 8–9 show BDE cooling and separate rack infrastructure.
current_architecture.additional_interfaces: PDS/CalCI interfaces and possible future TDE interfaces ↔ OPC UA ↔ SC/Ignition ↔ OPC UA ↔ DPS PLC; current TDE control is via PDUs only.
current_architecture.pdu_connection: SNMP control/status between DPS PLC and PDUs; grouped with LV supplies on the same connection; local interlocks retained

tde_scope.presentation: Keep PDU-only current control distinct from possible future crate-status and external-inhibit interfaces.

current_architecture.lv_supply_control: SNMP control/status between DPS PLC and LV power supplies, grouped with PDUs. Documented BDE/PL506 TTL enable/inhibit inputs remain additional hardware protection interfaces.
current_architecture.device_control_protocol: SNMP for both PDUs and WIENER LV power supplies
current_architecture.rack_infrastructure: Rack/enclosure, feeds, PDU(s), smoke/humidity sensors and sensor support/power/relay/wiring; temperature/leak where fitted. Count once and map subsystem loads to outlets. No humidity shutdown rule is inferred.
current_architecture.ffdg_route: API via Batavia server at FNAL → SC → DPS. Specific point availability remains to be mapped; this exchange itself adds no discrete/analog PLC terminals.
current_architecture.sdsta_route: Under investigation; available signals, controllers and connection points determine any interface hardware.
